newsitem.title: USA: Goody's CEO, officers offer 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Goody's CEO, officers offer 2 mln shares.

text.p: Goody's Family Clothing Inc said Wednesday it had filed for a public offering of 2,054,500 common shares, to be offered by Chairman and Chief Executive Robert Goodfriend and certain other company officers.
Goody's said in a news release that it will not receive any proceeds from the offering.
Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc and J.C. Bradford & Co were to manage the underwriting group for the offering.
Goody's is a retailer of moderately priced fashion apparel. Its shares were down 2-1/8 to 36-1/8 in afternoon Nasdaq trading.
